clue.text: Movie in which covetousness is finally denounced

definitions.meaning: the 1956 Cecil B DeMille epic film starring Charlton Heston

definitions.text: in which covetousness is finally denounced
definitions.meaning: the last of the biblical laws given at Sinai forbids coveting a neighbour's goods

explanation.surface: A film critic notes that greed only gets its comeuppance at the very end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Finally' points to the tenth and last of the laws, 'Thou shalt not covet'.
explanation.definitionFit: The title names both the Hollywood film and the decalogue whose last law condemns envy of others' possessions.

clue.text: Secures what's belonging to a part of church, we hear

indicators.note: signals that the phrase is spoken and the entry is a word with the same pronunciation

parts.words: what's belonging to a part of church
parts.note: a part of a church is a choir, and what belongs to it is 'a choir's'

explanation.surface: Someone obtains the possessions of a church section, it is rumoured.
explanation.definitionFit: To secure something is to obtain or get hold of it, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Opening hospital for mammal

parts.note: an opening is a slot, as in a slot for a coin
H is the standard abbreviation for hospital, seen on road signs

explanation.surface: A new hospital is being opened to treat animals.
explanation.definitionFit: The sloth is a slow-moving tree-dwelling mammal of South America, and also one of the deadly sins.

clue.text: College named after sinner — that sounds sentimental

indicators.note: tells us the entry is pronounced like a word meaning sentimental

parts.note: maudlin means tearfully or self-pityingly sentimental

explanation.surface: A college bearing a sinner's name strikes someone as rather soppy.
explanation.walkthrough: MAGDALEN is an Oxford college, named after Mary Magdalene, the penitent sinner of the Gospels; it is pronounced 'maudlin'.
explanation.definitionFit: Magdalen College, Oxford takes its name from Mary Magdalene, traditionally regarded as a reformed sinner.

clue.text: Some head for place of worship

definitions.meaning: part of the head, the flat area at the side of the forehead
a building devoted to worship of a god

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the side of the forehead and a building for religious worship.

clue.text: Pray with chap after conversion, holding old scriptures

indicators.note: the rearranged letters hold the next piece inside them
the letters of the two preceding words are converted into a new order

explanation.surface: A man prays after a religious conversion, clutching ancient sacred texts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is only a link; 'holding' means the converted letters (APCRYPHA) wrap around O, and the definition is just 'scriptures'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Apocrypha are ancient biblical writings, excluded from some versions of the scriptural canon.

clue.text: Work out if urge is wrong

indicators.note: the letters being wrong means they need putting in a different order

explanation.surface: Decide whether an impulse is a mistaken one.
explanation.definitionFit: To figure something out is to work it out or calculate it.

clue.text: Bad errors among today's clues and answers

definitions.text: Bad errors among today's clues and answers

parts.words: Bad errors among today's clues and answers
parts.note: the serious wrongdoings listed by the Church, several of which appear as solutions in this very puzzle

explanation.surface: A solver complains of serious mistakes in this crossword.
explanation.walkthrough: Errors are sins here, not misprints; pride, sloth and the others are entries elsewhere in the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: The traditional list of grave moral faults includes pride, envy, sloth and gluttony, all present in this crossword.

clue.text: Absolve old man in former sect heading east

indicators.note: the sect goes ahead of the compass point, leading it

parts.note: ex means former, as in ex-wife

indicators.note: the father goes inside the word for a sect

parts.note: a cult is a small religious sect
pa is an informal word for father, an old man

explanation.surface: A father is cleared after belonging to a sect that moved eastwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To exculpate someone is to clear them of blame, to absolve them.

clue.text: Animals banding together is what leads to destruction

definitions.meaning: a group of lions is called by this name

explanation.definitionFit: The word is the collective noun for lions and the arrogance that the proverb warns comes before a fall.

clue.text: Reckoned 1 or 8, for example, was important

definitions.meaning: the two long lists in this puzzle each come with a number, ten and seven

explanation.definitionFit: The word means tallied, describes numbered lists like the commandments and sins, and also means mattered.

clue.text: Epic, not totally true, perhaps, such as 1

indicators.note: signals that the letters may be arranged differently from how they appear
the word is not given in full, losing its final letter

parts.note: taken from the clue, then trimmed

explanation.surface: A grand film that is only partly faithful to the facts, like a famous biblical movie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not totally' cuts TRUE to TRU; 'perhaps' rearranges EPIC and TRU.
explanation.definitionFit: A picture is a film or movie, and the clue's example is the biblical epic at 1 Down.

clue.text: Saint's blemish

definitions.meaning: St ... the Evangelist, writer of the second Gospel
a spot, stain or scar on a surface

explanation.definitionFit: The word names the Gospel writer and also a spot or stain.

clue.text: Person suffering from 3? He's played badly, without energy

indicators.note: the jumbled letters stand outside, enclosing the next piece
something done badly is muddled, so the letters get jumbled

parts.note: the apostrophe is ignored, giving three letters
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A performer is criticised for playing poorly and without vigour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' rearranges HESPLAYED to SLEPYHEAD, and 'without' wraps that around E. 3 Down is SLOTH, laziness.
explanation.definitionFit: A sleepyhead is a drowsy or idle person, one afflicted by sloth.

clue.text: Church's including former students in defamatory statements

indicators.note: the church word surrounds the graduates

parts.note: CE is the Church of England, and the 's adds S
alumni are graduates or former students of a school

explanation.surface: A church is said to have put ex-pupils into slanderous remarks.
explanation.definitionFit: Calumnies are false and damaging statements made about someone, slanders.

clue.text: A bishop and saint contrived to avoid vice, maybe

parts.note: B is the chess notation abbreviation for bishop

indicators.note: the letters are contrived, worked into a new shape

explanation.surface: A clergyman and a holy figure arranged to steer clear of wrongdoing.
explanation.definitionFit: To abstain is to refrain from an indulgence, such as drinking, a vice.

clue.text: Holy man given cover, protected by mother

indicators.note: the headgear sits inside, sheltered by the word for mother

parts.note: mama is a childish word for mother
a hat is a head covering

explanation.surface: A holy man is given a shawl and kept safe by his mother.
explanation.definitionFit: Mahatma is an Indian title for a revered sage or holy person, as with Gandhi.

clue.text: Person breaking one of 1, mounted on racehorse

indicators.note: in a down entry, mounted means the letters go upwards, read backwards

parts.note: re means on or about, as in a letter heading
Red Rum was a famous British racehorse, three times winner of the Grand National steeplechase

explanation.surface: A killer is seen riding on top of a racehorse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mounted' reverses RE plus REDRUM. Red Rum is the famous Grand National winner whose name reversed is a well-known word for killing.
explanation.definitionFit: A murderer breaks the commandment 'Thou shalt not kill', one of the Ten Commandments.

clue.text: Misrepresent a very English saint in essay

indicators.note: the article, abbreviations and saint go inside the word for an attempt

parts.note: an essay is an attempt, a try

explanation.surface: An essay distorts the story of an English saint.
explanation.definitionFit: To travesty something is to represent it in a distorted or absurd way, a verb sense.

clue.text: Manifestations of lust rued by each involved

indicators.note: the letters are involved, tangled together into a new order

explanation.surface: Lustful displays are regretted by each person who took part.
explanation.definitionFit: Debauchery is excessive indulgence in sensual pleasures, the practical expression of lust.

clue.text: Locating envy, say, in begrudging guy, primarily

indicators.note: the sin example sits inside those first letters
the first letters of the two words are taken

parts.note: envy is an example of a sin, so 'envy, say' is A SIN

explanation.surface: Someone resentful is identified as jealous by a grudging fellow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'primarily' takes B and G from 'begrudging guy', and 'in' puts A SIN between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Basing something somewhere means locating or situating it there.

clue.text: Unusually honest player of 23 in 1

indicators.note: the letters appear in an unusual arrangement

explanation.surface: An actor in a biblical film is surprisingly truthful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unusually' rearranges HONEST. Charlton Heston played Moses (23) in The Ten Commandments (1).
explanation.definitionFit: Charlton Heston played the role of the prophet who led the Exodus in DeMille's 1956 film.

clue.text: Occur as lapse into sin

definitions.meaning: happen, as in 'Christmas will happen on a Tuesday'
Adam and Eve's original sin in Eden, or any moral lapse

explanation.definitionFit: The word means happen on a date and names humanity's original descent into sin.

clue.text: He led his race, but fell in sight of the finish

definitions.text: He led his race, but fell in sight of the finish

parts.words: He led his race, but fell in sight of the finish
parts.note: reads like an athlete who collapses near the line, but describes the leader of the Israelites who died viewing the Promised Land

explanation.walkthrough: The race is a people, not a contest: the prophet led the Israelites out of Egypt but died on Mount Nebo, seeing Canaan without entering it.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical prophet led the Israelites forty years but died just before they reached Canaan.

clue.text: Concentrates on removing head of church in sect

indicators.note: the concentrates are seen with a letter taken away

parts.note: essences are concentrated extracts of a substance

indicators.note: the first letter of the word is meant

explanation.surface: Extracts lose their church leader within a religious faction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on removing' takes away C ('head of church') from ESSENCES.
explanation.definitionFit: The Essenes were an ascetic Jewish sect of the Second Temple period.

clue.text: In demo, tersely, they dramatically express anger etc

indicators.note: the solution sits inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: At a protest march, curt people theatrically show their rage.
explanation.definitionFit: Emoters are people who display emotion, such as anger, in a theatrical way.

clue.text: Imperfect, perhaps — with a couple of 8, following part of 1

indicators.note: the two letters from 8 come after the part of 1

parts.note: the first word of 1 Down's title, ten

indicators.note: just the opening pair of letters is taken

parts.note: the first word of 8 Down's title, seven

explanation.surface: A grammar note: a flawed verb form goes with a pair of sins after a section of film.
explanation.definitionFit: The imperfect is a grammatical tense, describing ongoing past action.

clue.text: Finished with school, say, showed gluttony by having done this

definitions.text: showed gluttony by having done this

parts.note: over means finished, as in 'the game is over'

indicators.note: the school's name is spoken, giving a word sounding the same

parts.note: Eton is the famous English public school

explanation.surface: Someone done with school proves greedy by having done so.
explanation.walkthrough: ETON is England's best-known private boarding school.
explanation.definitionFit: Overeaten is the past participle of eating too much, which is what gluttony means.
